title: 2026 sea-transport Scope 3 and WTT QA controls

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Sea-transport conversion factors in this methodology are Scope 3 only.
They cover direct sea-transport emissions and WTT emissions for business travel and freight.
Passenger-ferry business-travel factors are intended for ferry trips taken for business purposes.
Sea WTT factors cover upstream extraction, refining and transport of ship fuels.
Sea factors remain constant from the 2021 publication, with GWP alignment updated in 2023.
There were no major sea-transport methodological changes in 2026.
RoPax direct factors use information from a study of mixed passenger-and-vehicle ferries on UK routes.
RoPax allocation uses passenger-km, tonne-km and fuel-consumption information and allocates CO2 between passenger and freight by transported tonnage assumptions.
Other cargo-ship CO2 factors use IMO cargo-ship efficiency estimates and represent international average data because UK-specific datasets are unavailable.
CH4 and N2O marine factors remain based on earlier shipping inventory relationships and are aligned to AR5 GWP values.
